subject: [enc4k] vc24 HEVC 4K hang: ran as a SECOND HEVC session in one process (after hvc1 1080p) -> vcodecd now restarts after any HEVC session; payload-vcodec-hevc4k bisect staged
body: vc24 vcodecd.log: hvc1 1080p (session 1, fresh process after the H.264->HEVC restart) OK, then hvc1 4K in the SAME process (same codec, no restart): INIT/SET_PARAM/sequence header OK (80 B), frame 0: power block 0 on, wait_irq(VENC) -60 after 1000 ms, then the 6 s encode timeout (detail 7011). No refused accesses in xnu-live.log (only the 'first VENC/VENC_C1 done' lines); the list waited on core 0 (irq 0), never core 1. Same signature as vc18 (HEVC after H.264: sequence-header job -60). H.264 after H.264 works (vc18/vc24). So the leading hypothesis is per-process vendor HEVC state that a second session does not re-establish, not 4K itself; one host-only difference to keep in mind: the HEVC 3840x2160 list writes VENC 0x1168=0x7a where every other size (incl. 4096x2160) writes 0x8a, and 0x0008 0x72a0 vs 0x73a0. Fix: vcodecd --restart-on-switch now also restarts on ANY OPEN after an HEVC session (log 'reopen after hevc -> ...'); IP 1088/1088; vcodecd cd733bac. Discriminator already in flight: vc25 (payload-vcodec-fast) runs hvc1 4K right after a restart (fresh process): works -> reopen bug; hangs -> 4K-specific. Its following hvc1 1080p60 runs as a reopen with the vc25 daemon (481a147b, no HEVC-reopen restart) and should hang if the hypothesis holds. Next payload: payload-vcodec-hevc4k (vcodecd cd733bac, keepalive): hvc1 4K30, hvc1 4K30 again, 3840x1088, 1920x2160, 1920x1080, each in a fresh process.
